Dear Stakeholder,
The survey below has been prepared to assess your opinions and expectations regarding the training services we provide as Gebze Technical University. Your evaluations will offer insights for us and guide our activities to serve you better. Therefore, careful completion of the survey is important. We thank you for your concern and contributions.
Please mark to what extent you agree with the statements below using the scale given below.
5- I strongly agree 4- I agree 3- I neither agree or disagree 2- I disagree 1- I strongly disagree N/A-Not Applicable
For us to be able to take your evaluation into consideration, please provide objective evidence in the opinions and suggestions part below for the criteria you rated as 1 and 2.
TRAINING INFORMATION | Training Title:….....

TRAINING | 1 | The training's purpose was efficiently explained.
2 | The scope of the training met its purpose and content.
3 | The training materials (tools, aids, documents) helped with my learning.
4 | The training venue was suitable for the training. (*If the training was held online, please respond with "N/A" for this criteria.)
5 | The training's duration was sufficient for the topics covered.
6 | I was able to participate easily in the trainings held online. (*If the training was held face to face, please respond with "N/A" for this criteria.)
TRAINER | 7 | The trainer had sufficient amount of knowledge in the training topic.
8 | The trainer covered the topics in a clear and comprehensible manner.
9 | Presentation skills of the trainer were sufficient.
TRAINING PRACTICES | 10 | The training contributed to my professional development.
11 | The training contributed to my personal development.
12 | The training helped me gain new knowledge and skills.
